name: Multi-format Publisher
purpose: Sanitized structural blueprint derived from the final V1 publisher.

publicBehavior.exclusiveClaim: claim and reread ownership before each publication boundary
publicBehavior.carouselPreparation: require exact child cardinality before parent publication
publicBehavior.ambiguousOutcome: protected from automatic retry; requires human reconciliation
publicBehavior.terminality: late branches cannot downgrade published or protected states

structureNote: Node names, positions, parameters, operational-resource connections and environment-specific values are intentionally abstracted. The final topology includes claim, preparation, polling, protected publish, outcome classification, terminality and synchronization stages.
